name: File Operations: Create, Write, Read, Delete
description: Create a file, write content to it, read it back, and then delete it. Tests execute_code and run_command step types.
context_rules: Always use the /tmp/decisions_test directory for file operations. Clean up after yourself.

steps.name: Create test directory
steps.description: Create the working directory for file operations

steps.name: Write content to file
steps.description: Create a file and write some text content to it using Python
steps.instruction: Create a file at /tmp/decisions_test/hello.txt and write 'Hello from DecisionsAI workflow! Timestamp: ' followed by the current datetime to it. Print confirmation message.

steps.name: Read and verify file content
steps.description: Read the file back and verify the content matches what was written
steps.instruction: Read the file /tmp/decisions_test/hello.txt and print its contents. Verify that it contains 'Hello from DecisionsAI'. Print 'VERIFIED' if it matches, or 'MISMATCH' if not.

steps.name: Delete test file and directory
steps.description: Clean up by deleting the test file and directory
steps.instruction: Delete the test file and directory
